original_tool.frozen_source_dependency: Use original immutable definition snapshot; materialize that declared local object if absent. Do not regenerate it from modified tasks.
original_tool.always_preparatory: Original code always returns status=not_accepted, release_certified=false and exit_code=1. A complete metadata ledger never substitutes for independent release acceptance.
original_tool.record_boundary: Historical engineering/platform receipts keep scoped_engineering and original source. Do not relabel them release_validation or edit source/status/digest to remove generated metadata gaps; applicability is a separately reasoned decision, not an automatic demand to rerun every old component.

manifest_fill_rules: Use actual immutable post-closeout state commit, actual selected release source and exact original digest format; null placeholders are intentionally not valid executable input.
Each evidence pointer needs full actual commit + regular repository path + original SHA256. Bare computed blob OIDs or signed URLs are not commit/path receipts.
Coverage labels come unchanged from the original frozen g8.validations and g8.release_checks. No new labels or gates are invented here.
Read status/source/input-digest JSON key paths from actual records; null stays unknown. Do not force historical records into a matching current-source assertion.
Preserve original errors, partials, timeouts and disabled/unavailable/null resources; do not pool different sources/profiles or convert standalone diagnostic samples into cohort observations.
